rules.title: Home rule petition authorizing Boston to implement rent stabilization (H.3744, 193rd Gen. Ct.)
rules.requirement: Proposed special law that would have authorized the City of Boston to implement rent stabilization. It was not enacted: it was sent to a study order on 9/9/2024 and the 2023-2024 session ended. No Boston rent stabilization rule exists under this bill.
rules.key_value: No rent cap enacted; bill sent to study order
rules.interaction: A home rule petition needs enactment by the General Court because state law (G.L. c.40P) bars local rent control without legislative authorization.
rules.quoted_span: that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.conflict_note: The document does not say 'failed' outright. Failed status is inferred from the 9/9/2024 'Accompanied a study order' action (H5035) and the end of the 193rd session. A refiled version in a later session could have a different status.

rules.title: Home rule petition authorizing Boston to implement tenant eviction protections (H.3744, 193rd Gen. Ct.)
rules.requirement: Proposed special law that would have authorized the City of Boston to implement tenant eviction protections. It was not enacted: it was sent to a study order on 9/9/2024 and the 2023-2024 session ended. No Boston just-cause eviction rule exists under this bill.
rules.key_value: No eviction protections enacted; bill sent to study order
rules.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.conflict_note: The document does not detail the eviction protections, so whether they were just-cause limits is inferred from the title. Failed status is inferred from the 9/9/2024 study-order action and the end of the 193rd session.
